products.name: Carpano Antico Formula Vermouth
products.tagline: Essential to your Manhattan, Old Fashioned or Negroni!
products.description: What can we tell you about Antica that you don't already know? If you are like us, you can't resist those welcoming floral and vanilla notes- especially since Manhattans and Old Fashions are never out of season. Add the fact that you can't make a Negroni without it and it's not much of a choice anymore.

products.name: Moxie Mule Vermouth Bianco
products.description:
This handcrafted vermouth checks three stellar boxes for us: local, Black-owned, and absolutely delicious!

This white vermouth is a lot more complex than many in this category. Slightly sweet, featuring orange peel, golden raisins, vanilla, licorice root, jasmine, calendula red rose, and wormwood. This definitely isn't just for your martinis!

Enjoy this vermouth year-round in spritzes, cocktails, or on its own over ice.

products.name: Cappelletti Apertivo
products.description: The Aperitivo Cappelletti, endearingly known to locals as just “Specialino”, may be the oldest style of the classic red bitter still in production. Unlike its larger commercial rivals, Cappelletti is less sweet and has a wonderful drying finish. Additionally, it still uses natural carmine color for a crimson red and retains a vinous texture from its wine base. It offers a vibrant and flavorful profile, complemented by bitter undertones on a traditional wine base. This yields a Negroni or Spritz that is dry and refreshing in the finish. It is made just outside of Trento in Alto Adige by the Cappelletti family, who also produce a number of other exceptional aperitivi and amari.

products.name: Cardamaro Vino Amaro
products.description: Cardamaro has the distinction of being the only wine bitter based on cardoon, an ingredient recognized as imperative to Piedmontese gastronomy. Warm spices, citrus, and floral notes give complexity and versatility to this amaro, and it can be enjoyed on its own with nuts and cheese as an aperitif or digestif. It also mixes well with ginger ale or whiskey, or it can be substituted for whiskey in a lighter-style Manhattan.

products.name: Cocchi Americano Bianco
products.description: Cocchi Americano was created in 1891 by Giulio Cocchi and since then produced without interruption according to the original recipe. Cocchi Bianco includes quinine and citrus for a flavorful, refreshing profile. In Piemonte it is served chilled with ice, a splash of soda and a peel of orange. The combination of fruit, spice and bitter undertones make is a fitting addition to many mixed cocktails. This same profile makes it splendid pairing with all kinds of pickles, nuts, charcuterie and cheeses.

products.name: Cocchi Americano Rosa
products.description: Cocchi Americano was created in 1891 by Giulio Cocchi and since then produced without interruption according to the original recipe. The name "Americano" is both due to the alcohol made bitter ("amaricato") by the addition of herbs and spices, and to the American habit of drinking vermouth with ice and soda. In Cocchi Americano Rosa, the Brachetto d'Acqui wine base provides the white rose and rich berry notes typical of the famous sparkling wine of the same variety, while the addition of rose and ginger to the traditional bitter base provides a rounder profile. Just add club soda or sparkling wine, or add a splash to cocktails for added depth.

products.name: Dolin Dry Vermouth
products.description: This iconic vermouth has been a staple across the Atlantic from its beginning, and was later immortalized by James Bond and his Dry Martini. Dry vermouth is still acclaimed by bartenders and mixologists from around the world. Slightly sweet, with a subtle golden tint, our dry vermouth has a generous and rich nose with hints of citrus bark underscored by the freshness of menthol and balsamic notes. Almond and stone fragrances dominate the slightly bitter citrus base and bring balance to the fine dry Vermouth de Chambéry.

products.name: Dolin Vermouth Blanc
products.description: The first white vermouth was created in Savoie in 1881. Sweet and aromatic, this Vermouth de Chambéry is a favorite for and remains a timeless symbol of elegance. It has clear brilliant color and a complex nose with aromas of freshly-picked Alpine botanicals, followed by camphor and then citrus notes. It has a pleasant harmony of botanical notes with a fine, silky texture. To complete the impression, the aromas of broom and elderflower in this white vermouth give way to notes of fresh almond and peach.

products.name: Dolin Vermouth Rouge
products.description: Dolin's red vermouth has a very long history, punctuated with many prizes and awards. It's recipe is unchanged since its inception. This vermouth has a lustrous coppery color, gentle aromas of fruit compote, prunes and walnuts with grassy notes, tempered by spicy aromas like Szechwan pepper. The hits keep coming with notes of almond, citrus, pear and cinnamon with gingerbread, and oregano.The very rich bouquet is tempered by a subtle bitter base wine. Perfect for your Negroni or Manhattan.

products.name: Lillet Blanc
products.description: Lillet Blanc is the original and most iconic apéritif in the LIllet line-up. Made mostly with Sémillon and Sauvignon grapes, it mixes beautifully in a simple spritz with an orange slice and elevates any classic cocktail. It has a floral aroma of mint & vanilla with flavors of candied orange, orange blossom, honey and pitted fruit.

products.name: Lillet Rose
products.description: With it's aromas of red berries, orange blossom & grapefruit, Lillet Rosé is a must-have for the spring and summer season! With its accessible, fresh and fruit-forward flavor, Lillet Rosé pairs perfectly with gin, tequila and Champagne!

products.name: Lillet Rouge
products.description: Compare to Lillet Blance, Lillet Rouge brings more fruit flavors and aromas for a richer, more deeply flavored experience. Made mostly with Merlot grapes, it has an aroma of ripe, dark fruits such as blackberry & plum. With flavors of fresh orange, ripe berries, vanilla & spice, its perfect for a spiced Sangria or your next Negroni!

products.name: Mattei Cap Corse Blanc, 750ml
products.description: A true Quinquina Blanc, and unique among aperitif wines. The profile of the Cap Corse Mattei BLANC aperitif wine is defined by its distinctly Corsican components. Its all-mistelle base is of Vermentinu and Muscat Petit Grains, lending a terrific minerality, acidity and floral tones. The local Cedrat (aka citron) adds unique citrus aroma and a silky texture. Since its creation in 1872 by Louis-Napoléon Mattei, Cap Corse Mattei is the oldest and best known aperitif of Corsica. Still today family owned, and all macerations, aging and bottling are done in house.

products.name: Mattei Cap Corse Rouge, 750ml
products.description: Among the most famous of French Quinquina, enjoyed for generations by visitors and residents of the Island of Corsica. It is composed of a variety of distinctive and aromatic spices, walnuts and cinchona bark on a base of Corsican Muscat and Vermentinu mistelles. The result is an aperitif of tremendous depth with a wonderfully dry finish. Traditionally served neat or on ice with tonic or soda. It mixes well with rye whiskey, apple brandy or brandy. Since its creation in 1872 by Louis-Napoléon Mattei, Cap Corse Mattei is the oldest and best known aperitif of Corsica. Still today family owned, and all macerations, aging and bottling are done in house.

products.name: Pasubio Vino Amaro
products.description: Pasubio is a true taste of the Dolomite Mountains in the Trentino region. On a base of rich aged wine you’ll find notes of blueberries, pine and smoke, together with bitter alpine herbs. It is rare among amari to feature mountain berries. The recipe from Giuseppe Cappelletti dates back to the early 20th century and is among the Erboristeria’s first amari. Traditionally enjoyed neat, typically at cellar temperature or chilled. Pasubio makes simple and delicious spritzes with tonic, soda, sparkling lemonade, or bitter lemon. Also pairs well in mixed drinks with bourbon, rye, or brandy.

products.name: Regal Rogue Lively White Vermouth
products.description: Regal Rogue Lively White is bursting with citrus and floral notes, marrying an Orange, organic un-wooded Chardonnay with native Lemon Myrtle, Desert Limes, Finger Limes and Native Thyme with Elderflower, Lemongrass, Grapefruit and Chamomile.It's semi-dry character make it perfect for citrusy, refreshing cocktails.

products.name: Trabanco Quinquina En Rama 750ml
products.description: Like most families from the Asturian countryside, the Trabancos have always made their own cider from their own apples, but in 1925 Emilio Trabanco decided to turn this household hobby into a family business. Trabanco cider quickly became known throughout the region as the premier natural cider from Asturias. Alma is the perfect aperitif produced by the blending of en rama cider with white wine and various botanicals steeped in vinous alcohol. The primary botanicals in Alma de Trabanco include cinchona, wormwood, savory, gentian, artemisia, boldo, cinnamon, star anise, coriander, thyme, and vanilla. Fruits include cherry, orange peel, and lemon. The flavor profile is bright, refreshing, and satisfying.
